text:
Elena M: @channel Quick heads-up — draft release notes are in PR. Can we lock the model pin and confirm canary timing? Planning: canary 13:00 PT, ramp to 20% at 13:15, full at 14:00 PT. Need copy + rollback phrasing.

Ben C: copying the RN link now. I'll skim for risky wording. Any special callouts for Dedicated vs Hosted?

Elena M: thanks Ben. Callout for Dedicated customers about the minor config change (pin behaviour) — short blurb under 'Known changes'. Keep it one sentence.

Rohit: pointer for infra: we'll schedule the capacity reserve at 12:30 PT. If deploy-bot flags any throttle we'll abort canary.

Sophie: RN PR looks fine. Suggest we add a short rollback sentence: `If regressions found, revert to v2026-02-14` and note contact for oncall.

Jordan: oncall for the window is @jordan (13:00–15:00 PT). I'll be watching traces and latency. If latency >+30% for 5m we trigger rollback.

Ben C: re: pin command — what's the exact artifact id?

Elena M: artifact: `redwood-infer:v1.9.3-quant`. pin command (ops):
```
# pin to v1.9.3-quant
./deployctl pin --service infer --model redwood-infer:v1.9.3-quant --scope hosted
```

Rohit: deploy-bot will post preflight in channel at 12:45 PT. If deploy-bot reports any incompatible kernels we'll delay.

deploy-bot: Preflight check scheduled at 12:45 PT. Running: model compatibility, kernel mismatch scan, quant tolerance smoke. Will post pass/fail.

Sophie: small wording nit: change "minor config change" to "config toggle for model pinning" so customers don't think data plane changes.

Elena M: done. Also adding the canary cue for support: "Support: monitor token-level latency, error-rate, and top-3 failing prompts."

Jordan: looks good. I'll +1 the PR after a final pass at 12:15 PT.

Ben C: I can be on standby for RN microcopy edits at 12:20 PT.

Elena M: great — final checklist: (1) RN copy approved, (2) pin command verified, (3) deploy-bot preflight pass, (4) oncall assigned. If all green we'll hit canary at 13:00 PT. :thumbsup:

Sophie: ack.

Rohit: will post capacity reserve note in infra channel at 12:35 PT.

Elena M: thanks team — I'll send the internal announcement at 12:40 PT locking the windows and the short rollback matrix.

Jordan: FYI if we need an immediate rollback the command is: `./deployctl rollback --service infer --to v2026-02-14`

Ben C: noted. Good luck :rocket:
